senses.definition: n.[m.] restraint (?), only יוֹרֵשׁ ע׳ Ju 18:7 a possessor of restraint, i.e. ruler, but 𝔊 𝔙 wealth, so Thes al., text very dub., cf. GFM; Bu conj. that ע׳ combines readings אֹצָר and עֹשֶׁר.
